name: near-entity-tracker
description: Online tracker of early investors in NEAR launchpad tokens: groups wallets by on-chain funding and money flow, scores each group, and uses NEAR AI to judge good / bad groups. Read-only on-chain, MongoDB as the main database.

scripts.test: node --test test/logic.test.js test/firewall.test.js test/audit.test.js test/incident.test.js test/destination.test.js test/prompts.test.js test/agent.test.js test/nearai.test.js test/ontology.test.js test/ring.test.js test/grounding.test.js test/fixtures.test.js test/truth.test.js test/security-accuracy.test.js test/pricehistory.test.js test/trail.test.js
